CeTTa record-visitor client
==========================

This optional client qualifies Cesta's record declarations against a pinned
CeTTa source capture. It does not edit a CeTTa checkout or need Lean.

  python3 adapters/cetta/run.py --cetta-repo REPOSITORY --cesta COMPILER

call_sources.records declares every member of PrimeNeedCallSourceCell. Its
common binding image and reference are unmoved episode holders: existing native
predicates must exclude both arenas that collection invalidates. Slot and fork
graphs retain their native, memoized holder audits. The outer hub loop retains
responsibility for the separately allocated cell list.

The generated function replaces the hand-written field walk in a private
source capture. The qualification checks actual field layouts and native
prototypes, positive lifetime cases, references and binding atoms in each
forbidden arena, and traversal through the next cell. It also compares Prime
answers and completed-collection accounting under forced collection.

frame_gate.records classifies every member of PrimeEvalStackFrame. It generates
the live-frame opaque-reference guard used before collection by the stack and
native-control collectors. Existing authority, frame-kind, retired-frame,
evacuation and unmoved-holder audits remain in place. A null-only gate is not
a complete collection-admission predicate. Bootstrap and final headers are
generated separately because their Need snapshot layouts differ.

The pinned consumer needs small strict-Clang compatibility edits. The runner
records each original and modified source hash in its evidence, including the
native C emitter changes needed by generated readers. It preserves warning
checks and retains both the ordinary and generated-audit executables.

The adapter is a declaration and generation pilot. Native graph predicates,
heap provenance, collector commit behavior and root discovery remain explicit
boundaries. Classifying the fields does not prove the entire collector safe.
